prompts.bug: Use case: stylized-concept. Production enemy sprite for a gritty late-2000s top-down mutant survival shooter. A SINGLE enemy, orthographic camera DIRECTLY OVERHEAD looking straight down at crown and back, absolutely not side view, not frontal portrait, not isometric. Enemy faces RIGHT, head toward 3 o'clock. Detailed hand-painted raster game art, dark organic texture, restrained highlights, warm green-brown palette and thick readable silhouette, NOT cartoon flat vector, NOT cute, no graphic outline. Entire creature centered with all limbs contained, occupies central 75% of square canvas with generous transparent margin. Transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow outside body, no text or labels, no UI, no other objects. Readable at 50px size. A mutated six-legged beetle with ochre-brown split chitin shell, segmented abdomen, angular splayed dark legs and two small forward mandibles. Compact insect anatomy, insect not humanoid, threatening pest.
